dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 features used; no vendor-specific extensions visible. Likely GnuCOBOL or similar open/educational compiler given author name and file naming conventions.

purpose.domain_detail: Trade/commerce reporting - reads trader data by province and generates a formatted report of province income and member statistics
purpose.summary: A batch program named TRADE-REPORT that reads a sequential trade data file (trader2.dat) containing province ID, trader ID, and trade income records, and produces a formatted report (report.rpt) with province income and member summaries. The program appears incomplete as the main processing logic beyond opening files and reading one record is not shown.

notable_features: Currency sign editing with $$$,$$$,$$9 picture clauses
OPEN INPUT used for report file (likely a bug - should be OUTPUT)
Program appears incomplete - PERFORM READ-TRADE-FILE with no loop or further processing
verdict.notes: The program is clearly incomplete or a fragment: TRADER-REPORT-FILE is opened as INPUT rather than OUTPUT (likely a bug), and there is no loop or accumulation logic despite having totals and detail line structures defined. The TOTALS working-storage group has PIC fields that don't match the FD print line width. Consistent with a student exercise. Author name 'Nipitpon' suggests Thai origin.
